arxiv-2104-06251.title: Energy Balance Within Thermonuclear Reactors
arxiv-2104-06251.creator: Mikhail V. Shubov
arxiv-2104-06251.description: Abstract Abstract Thermonuclear reactors hold a great promise for the future of Humankind. Within Tokamak and Stellarator reactors, plasma is confined by twisted magnetic fields. Reactors which produce fusion energy have existed since Princeton Large Torus Tokamak in 1978, nevertheless in all reactors built up to now, energy loss from plasma vastly exceeded fusion energy production.

arxiv-2205-04619.title: Risk Preferences of Learning Algorithms Note: We thank seminar audiences at Harvard and MIT and the mathoverflow.com user fedja for helpful conversations. Journal: Games and Economic Behavior
arxiv-2205-04619.creator: Andreas Haupt, Aroon Narayanan
arxiv-2205-04619.description: Abstract Agents’ learning from feedback shapes economic outcomes, and many economic decision-makers today employ learning algorithms to make consequential choices. This note shows that a widely used learning algorithm— ε \varepsilon -Greedy—exhibits emergent risk aversion: it prefers actions with lower variance.

arxiv-2303-13959.title: Bridging Stereo Geometry and BEV Representation with Reliable Mutual Interaction for Semantic Scene Completion
arxiv-2303-13959.creator: Bohan Li, Yasheng Sun, Zhujin Liang, Dalong Du, Zhuanghui Zhang, Xiaofeng Wang, Yunnan Wang, Xin Jin, Wenjun Zeng
arxiv-2303-13959.description: Abstract 3D semantic scene completion (SSC) is an ill-posed perception task that requires inferring a dense 3D scene from limited observations. Previous camera-based methods struggle to predict accurate semantic scenes due to inherent geometric ambiguity and incomplete observations. In this paper, we resort to stereo matching technique and bird’s-eye-view (BEV) representation learning to address such issues in SSC.

arxiv-2312-12554.title: Rectangle Search: An Anytime Beam Search (Extended Version)
arxiv-2312-12554.creator: Sofia Lemons, Wheeler Ruml, Robert C. Holte, Carlos Linares López
arxiv-2312-12554.description: Abstract Anytime heuristic search algorithms try to find a (potentially suboptimal) solution as quickly as possible and then work to find better and better solutions until an optimal solution is obtained or time is exhausted. The most widely-known anytime search algorithms are based on best-first search.

arxiv-2407-03661.title: Where’s That Voice Coming? Continual Learning for Sound Source Localization
arxiv-2407-03661.creator: Yang Xiao and Rohan Kumar Das
arxiv-2407-03661.description: Abstract Sound source localization (SSL) is essential for many speech-processing applications. Deep learning models have achieved high performance, but often fail when the training and inference environments differ. Adapting SSL models to dynamic acoustic conditions faces a major challenge: catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we propose an exemplar-free continual learning strategy for SSL (CL-SSL) to address such a forgetting phenomenon.

arxiv-2407-08295.title: Hybrid k k -Clustering: Blending k k -Median and k k -Center
arxiv-2407-08295.creator: Fedor V. Fomin, Petr A. Golovach, Tanmay Inamdar, Saket Saurabh, Meirav Zehavi
arxiv-2407-08295.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fedor V. Fomin, Petr A. Golovach, Tanmay Inamdar, Saket Saurabh, Meirav Zehavi. We propose a novel clustering model encompassing two well-known clustering models: k k -center clustering and k k -median clustering. arxiv-2506-05577.title: Collaborative Learning in Agentic Systems: A Collective AI is Greater Than the Sum of Its Parts
arxiv-2506-05577.creator: Saptarshi Nath, Christos Peridis, Eseoghene Benjamin, Xinran Liu, Soheil Kolouri, Peter Kinnell, Zexin Li, Cong Liu, Shirin Dora, Andrea Soltoggio
arxiv-2506-05577.description: Abstract Agentic AI has gained significant interest as a research paradigm focused on autonomy, self-directed learning, and long-term reliability of decision making. Real-world agentic systems operate in decentralized settings on a large set of tasks or data distributions with constraints such as limited bandwidth, asynchronous execution, and the absence of a centralized model or even common objectives.

arxiv-2507-05477.title: Epistemically-guided forward-backward exploration
arxiv-2507-05477.creator: Núria Armengol Urpí, Marin Vlastelica, Georg Martius, Stelian Coros
arxiv-2507-05477.description: Abstract Zero-shot reinforcement learning is necessary for extracting optimal policies in absence of concrete rewards for fast adaptation to future problem settings. Forward-backward representations ( FB ) have emerged as a promising method for learning optimal policies in absence of rewards via a factorization of the policy occupancy measure.

pmc-11349101.title: Development and validation of a practical score to predict 3-year distant metastatic free survival in nasopharyngeal carcinoma incorporating the number of lymph node regions
pmc-11349101.creator: Thitiporn Jaruthien, Chawalit Lertbutsayanukul, Nutchawan Jittapiromsak, Aniwat Sriyook, Prapasri Kulalert, Pichaya Tantiyavarong, Sarin Kitpanit, Danita Kannarunimit, Chakkapong Chakkabat, Anussara Prayongrat, Lu Zhang, Lu Zhang, Lu Zhang
pmc-11349101.description: IntroductionThe improvement in diagnosis and treatment for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) has shifted the pattern of failure toward distant metastasis. This study aimed to develop a simplified prognostic scoring model to predict distant metastatic free survival (DMFS) for NPC patients.Materials and methodsPatients with non-metastatic NPC were identified from a retrospective cohort diagnosed between 2010 and 2018.

pmc-11360193.description: Increasing the effectiveness of vaccines against respiratory viruses is particularly relevant for the elderly, since they are prone to develop serious infections due to comorbidities and the senescence of the immune system. The addition of saponin-based adjuvants is an interesting strategy to increase the effectiveness of vaccines. We have previously shown that ISCOM matrices from Q.

pmc-11416742.title: Self-Medication Practice and Associated Factors Among Pregnant Women Residing in Kattankulathur Block of Chengalpattu District in Tamil Nadu, India: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11416742.creator: Ezhil Muthalvan, Kaveri P, Logaraj M, Anantharaman VV
pmc-11416742.description: BackgroundSelf-medication is a prevalent phenomenon worldwide. The self-medication practiced by pregnant women, particularly during the first trimester, can have significant adverse consequences for both the developing fetus and the mother. Although self-medication during pregnancy has the potential to cause adverse effects, there is less information regarding the consequences among pregnant women in low-middle-income countries, such as India.

pmc-12461220.title: Efficient hyperparameter estimation in Bayesian inverse problems using sample average approximation
pmc-12461220.creator: Julianne Chung, Scot M Miller, Malena Sabate Landman, Arvind K Saibaba
pmc-12461220.description: In Bayesian inverse problems, it is common to consider several hyperparameters that define the prior and the noise model that must be estimated from the data. In particular, we are interested in linear inverse problems with additive Gaussian noise and Gaussian priors defined using Matérn covariance models.

pmc-12636204.title: A mixed-methods study on awareness of sexual and reproductive rights among women in Chandigarh, India
pmc-12636204.creator: Zawata Afnan, Madhu Gupta, Kapil Goel, Yukti Bhandari, Immanuel Joshua
pmc-12636204.description: BackgroundSexual and reproductive rights (SRRs) include the ability to make informed choices about family planning and reproductive health, free from discrimination, coercion, or violence. This study aimed to assess awareness and identify factors influencing perceptions of reproductive rights among women aged 15–35 years in Chandigarh.

pmc-12729636.title: Low-Coverage Whole-Genome Sequencing (lcWGS) in Cattle: Analysis of Potential and Prospects for Application
pmc-12729636.creator: Olga Kostyunina, Nikita Koldichev, Gleb Nemkovskiy, Alexey Traspov, Anton Ermilov, Faridun Bakoev, Dmitriy Chesnokov, Anna Panova, Kseniia Antonovskaia, Alexander Kusnetzov, Vladimir Belyakov, Gabriella Holló, Ferenc Szabó
pmc-12729636.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryLow-coverage whole-genome sequencing (lcWGS) allows reading a small portion of each animal’s DNA across the entire genome at low cost. When combined with computational methods, this approach can accurately reconstruct full genetic profiles. This review shows that lcWGS is effective for cattle genomics: it captures rare and breed-specific genetic variants better than standard SNP chips, supports accurate genomic predictions, and becomes cost-competitive.

pmc-12749058.title: Miniaturized broadband lowpass filter based on the integrated square dumbbell and meander structure spoof surface plasmon polaritons
pmc-12749058.creator: Lingling Yang, Wentao Ye, Bin Cai, Can Cao, Yongzhi Cheng
pmc-12749058.description: A novel miniaturized broadband low-pass filter (LPF) is proposed based on the integrated square dumbbell and meander (SDBM) structure spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs). Compared with the conventional H-shaped and square dumbbell structure SSPP unit-cells, the integrated SDBM structure can effectively reduce its asymptotic frequency, revealing much better slow-wave characteristics.

pmc-13199849.title: Integrating spatial and single-cell transcriptomics via machine learning to characterize efferocytosis in hepatocellular carcinoma prognosis and immunotherapy
pmc-13199849.creator: Qiuyun Yi, Bin Zhou, Xiaohui Gu, Zihui Ma, Bochen Pan, Zhou Yuan, Wen Wen, Chongde Lu
pmc-13199849.description: Highlights•We built an Efferocytosis-Related Scoring System (ERG score) for HCC prognosis.•A machine learning model with 10 genes was built to predict patient survival.•SPP1+ macrophages drive high efferocytosis and an immunosuppressive TME.•SPP1+ macrophages interact with malignant cells via the MDK-SDC2 axis.•TPI1 was identified as a core gene and validated through in vitro experiments.

pmc-13302476.title: Single-Stage Reverse High Tibial Osteotomy and Total Knee Arthroplasty for Valgus Extra-Articular Deformity After Failed HTO: A Matched-Pair Pilot Study †
pmc-13302476.creator: Maximilian Jörgens, Wolfgang Reng, Julian Karpf, Edna De la Ossa Cordoba, Steffen Klingbeil, Rolf Schipp, Johannes Becker
pmc-13302476.description: Background: High tibial osteotomy (HTO) is an established joint-preserving treatment for medial knee osteoarthritis, but total knee arthroplasty (TKA) may be required if the disease progresses. This pilot study evaluates the radiological and functional outcomes of simultaneous limb axis correction using reverse HTO (rHTO) during TKA compared to a primary TKA control group without previous HTO.

pmc-13633884.title: Unusual manifestations of chest wall tuberculosis: diagnostic challenges in two cases from a low-incidence tuberculosis country
pmc-13633884.creator: Mahmoud Yehya, Bhagwan Mantri, Abubaker S Ahmed, M S Abdelfattah, Mhmad Othman J Albaghdadi
pmc-13633884.description: Chest wall tuberculosis (TB) is a rare manifestation of extrapulmonary TB and may present a significant diagnostic challenge, particularly in low-incidence TB countries such as the United Arab Emirates. We report two unusual cases of chest wall TB with distinct clinical presentations.
